# Check that a destination is a marketplace page

> `validateDestination` makes sure a short link can only point at the marketplace's own web pages, and strips the `ref` tracking parameter before the link is saved.

_Part of [Creating and resolving share links](share-short-links.md)_

A shortener that redirects anywhere is a phishing tool, so every new link goes through `validateDestination` in [`ShareLinkService`](link-click-analytics.md) before anything is stored. It is the first line of `create`, which runs it before the code is made or anything is written. See [Creating and resolving share links](share-short-links.md) for the full create/resolve flow. The check runs in order. First it tries to parse the text as an absolute URL, and fails with a 422 (`UnprocessableEntityException`) if it can't. Next it accepts only `http:` and `https:`, so things like `javascript:` are out. Then it compares the URL's host with the [Set of hosts a short link may point to](allowed-marketplace-hosts.md). Any other host gets a 422 saying links may only point to marketplace pages. Last, it deletes the `ref` query parameter and returns the cleaned URL. `create` stores that cleaned version (`url.toString()`) as the link's destination. The source doesn't say why `ref` is removed.

**Look at:** [share-link.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts) · [`allowedHosts` in share-link.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts#L51)

## Pieces

- [Set of hosts a short link may point to](allowed-marketplace-hosts.md): Built in the [`ShareLinkService`](link-click-analytics.md) constructor from the `front_host` config: the front-end host plus the same host with `www.` in front.
- Removing the ref query parameter from the destination: The last step deletes `ref` from the URL's query string, so the stored destination no longer carries it.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| other | ```front_host`` config value` | Read once in the constructor to work out the allowed hosts. It is read through [`ApiConfigService`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/common/config/api-config.service.ts#L44). |

## Also relies on

- [Creating and resolving share links](share-short-links.md): It is the open-redirect guard that `create` in the share link flow calls before storing a link.

## Watch out

- The comparison uses `url.host`, which includes the port. A marketplace URL with a non-default port will be rejected unless `front_host` has that same port.
- Only the front-end host and its `www.` version are allowed. Other subdomains are rejected.
- Both `http:` and `https:` are accepted, so an `http` destination is stored as given.
- The check runs only when a link is created. `resolve` doesn't re-check the stored destination.
